failure_patterns.pattern: dropped_requested_domain_in_first_search: First search block covered only one domain. T1 (flight+hotel with '4 rooms for 5 nights'), T5 (flights cached, hotel+attractions asked) and T7 (flight+hotel, dates given) each omitted the hotel search.

rejected_edits.content: Add only params the user stated anywhere in the conversation: a stated flight_class or airline goes into BOTH legs (a class named in turn 1 -> flight_class=["<class>"] on departure_flights and return_flights). Never invent an airline, budget, times or num_people.
rejected_edits.target: Add no other params: no airline, flight_class, budget, times or num_people.

rejected_edits.content: - Search every requested domain that has no key and complete args in the same block (flights + hotel, hotel + attractions + search_nearest when asked). Leave domains that already have a key untouched (e.g. restaurants already cached, now the hotel dates arrive: call search_hotels only).
rejected_edits.target: - Search only the domain whose mandatory args just became complete. Leave other domains' existing cache entries untouched (e.g. restaurants already cached, now the hotel dates arrive: call search_hotels only).
